analysis.title: GS Futures Global Bonds CTA - Market Update - October 26, 2026
key_insights: As of Friday's close all 9 modeled short-term bond trend signals are positive, after several updates in which they sat near threshold levels.
The JGB medium-term trend signal sits at its threshold level.
Baseline flow forecasts show relatively large buying from the systematic trend-following (CTA) cohort in rates over the next week and month.
Over the next week the desk estimates CTAs will buy $23mm DV01 of rates, split relatively evenly across products, with larger forecast buying in JGBs.
Over one month the desk estimates CTAs will buy upwards of $71mm DV01 if current trends persist, which would trim their net short position by half.
risk_factors: The forecasts assume current trends persist.
The desk's backtested and simulated results are illustrative, with no assurance the strategy would have operated consistently in the past.
vol_and_positioning: CTAs hold a net short position in global bonds, estimated to be cut by half if the one-month forecast of $71mm DV01 buying is realized.
One-week CTA flow forecast is $23mm DV01 of rate buying, spread relatively evenly across products, with larger JGB forecasts.
All 9 modeled short-term bond signals are positive as of Friday's close, and the JGB medium-term trend is at its threshold.
